glădĭātūra , ae, f. gladius, gladiator,
I.a fighting of gladiators, or their profession (post-Aug. and very rare): “adduntur e servitiis gladiaturae destinati,” Tac. A. 3, 43 : ut requiem gladiaturae haberet, Schol. Juv. 6, 105; Firm. 5, 27.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
